body: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by aggregate accuracy, with speech amplifying partial failures. We make the benchmark publicly available to the community.
summaryZh: 本文针对多模态大模型在语音与文本模态转换及跨语言场景下的表现进行了深入研究。作者发现，语义等价的查询在不同模态和语言（英语与阿拉伯语）下会导致模型判断不一致，且语音模态往往会放大这种部分推理失败的现象。为此，研究团队构建了一个包含10,150张文化相关图像的对比三元组基准测试，旨在量化评估模型在多模态交互中的稳定性，为提升语音优先助手的可靠性提供了重要参考。

glossary.explanationZh: 能够处理文本、图像、语音等多种模态数据的通用大模型。
指模型在处理语义等价但模态或语言不同的输入时，产生判断不一致的现象。
指在基准测试中引入语音输入以评估模型跨模态处理能力。
在包含图像及多个陈述的三元组任务中，模型无法一致性地完成所有判断的错误。
